decisions.reason: Launched in 2018 as a close-to-core product line with several models, its sunk investments and public commitment make withdrawal unlikely.
The education institute builds on the firm's established training offer and supports customer success, so management will likely persist despite weak website visibility.
The support tool complements the core software and has absorbed development effort, making persistence consistent with escalation of commitment.
The analytics dashboard aligns with the firm's announced digital and connected direction and is close to its core offer, so escalation pressures favor keeping it.
The complete dental practice bundle is close to the established offer and central to sales strategy, making early withdrawal unlikely.
The job and practice listing portal is distant from the firm's core and announced direction, weakening escalation of commitment and making drop more likely.
